domain.title: Stories
domain.description: Two interconnected narratives from the first 17 pages — how global digital infrastructure is built, and how people interact with digital systems.

source_scope: First 17 pages only (Batches 1+2, Cards A–H). Provisional learning paths, not direct-evolution claims.

cards.title: Story A — How global digital infrastructure is built
cards.path: Communication needs → businesses and governments → standards and regulation → manufacturers and vendors → physical networks → hardware/software integration
sourceCardTitles: Why networks exist: origins and business need
Naming, addressing and regulation: directory to DNS
Hardware supply and the NIC endpoint
The NIC and kernel stack, plus out-of-band management
Building, operating and approving a product
The universal product: four parallel flows, cross flow, and the full value chain
Who controls and who builds: government layer, global oversight, and government networks
cards.canonical_note: Source Cards A–G remain canonical; this Story card aggregates their related notes and links back to them.

cards.title: Story B — How people interact with digital systems
cards.path: Telegraph interfaces → early computer interfaces → desktop GUI → web applications → mobile/cloud → real-time and AI-assisted interfaces
sourceCardTitles: How the interface changed: from telegraph keys to real-time, XR, and AI UI's
cards.canonical_note: Source Card H remains canonical; this Story card aggregates its related notes and links back to it. Batch 3 Card J expands Story B, but is not included in this first-17 scope.

meeting_points: E↔H approval/platform gates (forward link to J, Batch 3)
